title: RVanDamme/muffin pipeline - params.coverage_input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.coverage_input: extra read sets mapped to every assembly for differential-coverage binning

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

short_reads_1.errorMessage: Short reads R1 file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

short_reads_2.errorMessage: Short reads R2 file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

long_reads.errorMessage: Long (ONT) reads file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

items.errorMessage: Each coverage sample needs a complete short-read pair (short_reads_1 and short_reads_2), long reads (long_reads), or both
